scope: Read-only review of frozen build473 four-file diff and geometry_merit473_design.json; no source edits or jobs.
finding: No production correctness blocker identified in EntityFaceError. The extra query is guarded by a valid over-2tau upper, uses the unchanged support and physical triangle, takes min of upper bounds, and preserves maximum floor and strict geometry gate.
verified_safety_points: Direct branch reaches the helper only when budget is nonnull; cross-binding branch rejects a null budget before support discovery/query.
Direct calls retain exact one-facet support; cross calls reuse their entity-filtered discovered support; maximum floor is returned with the tightened bound.
2tau query is a distinct tolerance-keyed memo entry. Failed BoundPhysicalSurface calls do not store a result; geometry_certificates assignment remains after complete census succeeds.
Final GeometryCertificates comparisons still use GeometryTolerance; entity certificate maps are not serialized as cached query results.

test_coverage_limitation.finding: The successful outside-face call computes and caches the 2tau bound before the limited-budget assertion. The limited attempt therefore exhausts work at the extra 2tau memo lookup; it does not test interruption of an uncached 2tau refinement or absence of a partial memo after such interruption.
test_coverage_limitation.recommended_followup: Use a fresh authority/cache for the limited attempt, allowing the strict query to complete and stopping work during the uncached 2tau query; assert no false pass and a later full-budget recomputation agrees.

scope_limits: The serial 52-tag and MPI 41-case reports are separate validation evidence; this static review did not run tests.
The query policy does not establish broad geometry closure, accepted mesh/BL readiness, or a performance improvement without complete M6 trajectory evidence.
The current residual control MoveVertex probe is test-only and not evidence of production candidate acceptance.
